title: Cutting Ranks
wikitext: {{Questbox | name=Anchor's End | start=[[Warbringer Dar'nakk]] | faction=Horde | id= | level=19 | category=Durotar | reputation = +300 [[Orgrimmar (faction)|Orgrimmar]] | experience = 1650 | rewards = | previous = [[A War Worth Fighting]] | next = [[Lieutenant Alverold (quest)|Lieutenant Alverold]] }} == Objectives == Slay 10 Expedition Officers, Hydromancer Shaleborn, and Deckmaster Darkhollow for Warbringer Dar'nakk in Razor Hill. * [[Expedition Officer]] (10) * [[Hydromancer Shaleborn]] * [[Deckmaster Darkhollow]] == Description == If we wish to utterly dismantle the Expedition Fleet, then we must crush the head of the snake: Captains, commanders, officers and other figures of interest. The Shattered Hand Clan was kind enough to provide me with a list of their names. Go to Anchor's Edge, south of the Echo Isles in southeastern Durotar. Once you arrive, you must look for and kill Hydromancer Shaleborn and Deckmaster Darkhollow, along with any breathing officer on the isle . Their whole leadership shall crumble! == Progress == It must be done, their leaders must die. They, more than the luckless footsoldiers they throw at us, are at fault for the persecution of our people. Do not forget it. == Completion == It is done, then. With their chain of command gone, it might take months for their expedition to re-organize. We shall not give them such a luxury. ==Notes== ;Upon accepting this quest and {{questlong|Horde|17|Anchor's End}} :'''Warbringer Dar'nakk says:''' Baha! A true soldier of the Horde! One of grit and steel — those Kul Tirans are no match for you! ==Progression== {{The Second Wave}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.16.4|note=Added.}}
